title: Workshop
lead: Themes, questions and missions the games use. See what's live, vote on what's coming and suggest your own.

card.copied: Link copied. Whoever opens it lands right on the vote.
card.votes: {n, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} · {pct}% want to play
card.signIn: Sign in with an account to vote.

wordHint: Up to 20 letters, without naming the card

toneHints.contest: The lineups face off; comes up about 1 round in 5.

empty.voting: Nothing up for a vote here.
empty.hint: Change the filter or suggest something new.

compose.title: Suggest to the Workshop
compose.lead: Anyone can vote. Every suggestion is reviewed before it goes into the game.
compose.needGame: Pick at least one game to send.
compose.themeGamesHint: Themes are drawn in Who am I? and Impostor. Build the Team doesn't use themes.
compose.questionGamesHint: Questions only exist in Impostor: everyone answers about their own card.
compose.missionGamesHint: The mission comes out of the envelope after the auction. It works for any taste: the lots come from the tastes the room left on.
compose.setHint: It's the group the host turns on or off in the room.
compose.startersHint: At least 3, up to 5. They show up in the rule, in the picker's hand and in the Impostor draw.
compose.noResults: Nobody matching “{q}”. Create the character in Characters and come back.
compose.fiveEnough: Five is enough. Remove one to swap.
compose.tastesHint: They come from the example characters. A room that turns these tastes off won't draw the theme.
compose.tastesEmpty: Pick the examples to see the tastes.
compose.startersLangHint: Use “{lang} only” for examples that are only famous here.
compose.question: Question
compose.audienceOnly: Only comes up when the cards are {what}.
compose.spiceHint: Spicy only comes up after the match's first vote.
compose.missionPh: Change a tire, in the rain, at midnight.
compose.heavyHint: Only goes into rooms that allow heavy missions.

translations.missing: {n, plural, one {# text missing} other {# texts missing}} · tap to write
translations.hint: Optional: the reviewer fills in whatever is missing. Players in other languages see these texts.

rule.title: In the opening of Who am I?
rule.must: Every character must belong to this theme
rule.cartoon: someone from a cartoon or game
rule.mixed: No ✗: the examples mix fiction and real people.
rule.setMixed: This set doesn't show ✗: it mixes fiction and real people.

checks.near_theme: A theme like this already exists: “{ref}”.
checks.near_themeHint: Look for it in the Themes tab before suggesting again.
checks.same_startersHint: Swap at least one so the theme has its own identity.
checks.no_pictureHint: The examples show up in the rule and in the picker's hand: swap for someone with a picture, or add a picture on the character sheet.
checks.near_textHint: Change the meaning, not just the words.
checks.blocked_word: It has a word that isn't allowed.

compose.left: {n, plural, =0 {No suggestions left this week.} one {1 suggestion left this week.} other {# suggestions left this week.}}
compose.weekDone: You've already sent 3 suggestions this week. You can send more on Monday.
compose.sent: Suggestion sent. You can already vote on it.
compose.needStarters: {n, plural, one {# example character missing.} other {# example characters missing.}}
compose.signInHint: Suggestions carry the name of whoever suggested them. Sign in with Discord or Google.
compose.placeholderMission: Your mission shows up here, inside the envelope.

reviewPage.title: Review
reviewPage.lead: What the community suggested, from most to least loved. Fill in the languages and put it live, or leave it out and say why.
reviewPage.reasonPh: E.g. hardly anyone recognizes the examples.
reviewPage.approved: Live. The new entry is out.
reviewPage.needAll: Fill in all four languages to put it live.
